title: Relationship Exposure Standard for Larkspur Credit Cards Limits
content:
Under this credit risk standard, the limits on the Larkspur Credit Cards are assessed together with the customer's other unsecured Larkspur credit.

## The standard

1. Card limits are assessed together with the customer's other unsecured Larkspur credit. The sum of the customer's card limits, FlexLine limit and unpaid personal loan principal, after the new limit, may not exceed USD 100000.00 (one hundred thousand dollars).
2. An unsecured card is not opened, and no limit is increased, while any Larkspur personal loan, FlexLine or PracticePay plan of the customer is more than 30 days past due or charged off.
3. The secured card's limit is its deposit and is outside the cap.

## When the standard is applied, and on what evidence

- **When:** the standard applies when a card account opens and when a card's credit limit changes. It is settled before that action, from the system records.
- **What is summed:** all of the following, for the same customer:
  - the credit limits on the customer's Larkspur Credit Cards accounts;
  - the credit limit of the customer's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line;
  - the unpaid principal balance of the customer's Personal Loans.
- **Which card limits:** the new limit is included in the sum. For a newly opened card, its limit is added. For a limit change, the card is counted at its new limit. A Larkspur Secured Visa limit is left out, because that limit is its deposit and sits outside the cap.
- **Boundary:** the sum may equal 100000.00. It may not exceed it.

## The past-due bar

The second paragraph of the standard looks at the customer's Personal Loans, FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit and PracticePay Patient Financing plans. While any one of them is more than 30 days past due or charged off:

- no unsecured card is opened; and
- no card limit is increased.

"More than 30 days" means 31 days or more. A plan that is exactly 30 days past due does not trigger the bar.

## Hypothetical sums

All figures below are invented round numbers. Take a customer with:

- unsecured card limits of 20,000.00,
- a FlexLine limit of 30,000.00,
- unpaid personal loan principal of 40,000.00.

Before any new limit, the sum is 90,000.00.

| Proposed new card limit | Sum after the new limit | Within the cap of 100000.00? |
|---|---|---|
| 10,000.00 on a new unsecured card | 100,000.00 | Yes, because it is equal and does not exceed |
| 10,000.01 on a new unsecured card | 100,000.01 | No, because it exceeds |
| An existing card limit raised by 5,000.00 | 95,000.00 | Yes |
| A new Larkspur Secured Visa with a 2,000.00 deposit | 90,000.00, since the secured limit sits outside the cap | Not counted against the cap |
